## Changes

- Add `markdown-width` to limit Markdown lines to 300 characters by default; configure the limit with `--max-chars`.
- Add `code-length` to reject code files over 1,000 lines by default; configure the limit with `--max-lines`.
- Raise the default directory file limit from 15 to 20.
- Allow consuming repositories to override the bundled Oxlint policy with a root Oxlint configuration.
- Make `unbold` opt-in in the example configuration.
- Rename the `unslop` hook to `unslop-prose`; update the hook id in `prek.toml` when upgrading.
- Move `repetition.loaded-word` out of the recommended preset; strict reports it as information. A fixed word list cannot tell "landscape fabric" from "the AI landscape".

Copy the updated `example_conf/prek.toml` when upgrading to enable the new hooks and adopt the default changes.
